$comment: Acceptance coverage ledger (#82, ADR-0001): every user-facing flow declares how it is covered — automated (playwright-e2e / storybook / unit-dom), manual (with a reason), or deferred (with an issue). check-e2e-coverage-map.mjs validates shape and path existence; check-acceptance-coverage-diff.mjs forces updates alongside renderer changes. Each epic seeds its own entries.

coverage.reason: Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Semantic-Search.md in packaged macOS and Windows builds to verify real model retrieval quality, the search mode menu with pointer, keyboard, and a screen reader (#1291), assistive-technology announcements, and foreground/background scheduling with production assets.

OS-level reduced-motion toggling and subjective readability at 200% text scaling require the physical macOS/Windows acceptance pass documented in docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Visual-Accessibility.md.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Visual-Accessibility.md in packaged macOS and Windows builds to verify live Increase Contrast, native forced-colors theme changes, user-theme precedence, photo chrome, and physical assistive-technology behavior.

Follow step 2 of the 200% zoom pass in docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Visual-Accessibility.md in packaged macOS and Windows builds: the toolbar stays one row at the collapsed level (settled by the shared collapse helper, `components/collapse-level.ts`), and every control is reachable by Tab in order with a screen reader running.

In a packaged build, check that the selection pill's More button and the per-photo and per-album action buttons show the ellipsis glyph, and that their accessible names are unchanged with a screen reader running.

Follow the 200% zoom pass in docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Visual-Accessibility.md in packaged macOS and Windows builds with a selection: the pill stays one line, ⋯ holds exactly the actions missing from the pill, and a screen reader announces an unavailable Export with its reason.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Context-Menus.md to verify native pointer placement, viewport-edge clamping, screen-reader announcement, and cross-surface focus restoration that automated lanes cannot fully observe.

A packaged macOS VoiceOver pass follows docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Quick-Actions.md to verify modifier announcements, Command-click safety, app deactivation cleanup, and parity of pointer, keyboard, context-menu, and touch-visible access.

entries.$note: #689 rebuilt the macOS bar to the design-system six-menu spec (Overlook · File · Edit · View · Photo · Help). Structure/order/accelerators/target-aware enablement are asserted by application-menu.spec.ts (`…six-menu design-system spec…`) and application-menu-model.test.ts. The follow-up wired the new commands to their handlers — Toggle Sidebar and the Export parity path are exercised by application-menu.spec.ts (`…drive their shared handlers (parity)`), the sidebar reducer by app-state.test.ts; the router lives in use-native-command-router.ts and shares handlers with the toolbar/context menu (ADR-0024).

coverage.reason: A packaged macOS pass follows docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Native-Application-Menu.md to verify native menu placement, inactive/hidden focus restoration, Services and OS roles, and assistive-technology behavior that the hidden Electron harness cannot observe.

Live provider credentials and the packaged signed iCloud host are owner-run closeout evidence in issue #337. Verify selection, album, lightbox, and settings entry points; exact review and custody counts; keyboard and narrow states; preserved selection/view/album; honest unavailable originals; and no backup namespace reuse.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Gallery-Inclusion.md against a library holding corrupt and undecodable files to verify the Unavailable source, its repair transitions, and a backup/restore that preserves the inclusion rules.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Album-Visibility.md with a photo that belongs to two albums to verify the inclusion-wins disclosure, and a backup/restore that preserves which albums are hidden.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Album-Folders.md for the six-level depth bound, the move-children deletion path, and a backup/restore that preserves folders, placements, folder policies, and tags.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Smart-Albums.md for the megapixel and tag facets over a real library, the relaunch check, the folder deletion count that names Smart Albums apart, and the fail-closed empty state for a newer predicate version.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Feed-View.md for the responsive column, the progressive fade and its reduced-motion variant, the offloaded and unavailable states, Trash retention labels, and screen-reader announcements over a real library.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Persisted-Edits.md for the offloaded-original deferral, the newer-format view-only state, the relaunch check, and the restore fidelity check over a real library.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Perceptual-Duplicates.md for the offloaded-original, missing-preview and interruption checks, and with a screen reader running, move each candidate to Trash from the keyboard: focus lands on the next candidate and the groups left are announced (#1305).

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Backup-Coverage.md for the shared-original retention, the disconnected and offloaded-original paths, the refused delete and its retry, the purge and disaster-recovery checks, and the pre-35 library upgrade over a real library.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Keyring.md for the relaunch persistence of locked photos, the impostor key file, the restore from a bootstrap that lacks a key, and the pre-36 library upgrade over a real library.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Disclosure-Policy.md for the Send to Apple Photos refusal over the real bridge, the File Provider date in Finder, and the relaunch persistence of a changed class. Check the Destination choice (Named recipient · Public) with its hint and the neutral class badges in dark, light and high contrast, and that a screen reader hears the blocked notice politely, not as an alert (#1308). Consent copy in the preview reads at --text-sm body; only the loading, empty and decline notes are faint (#1309).
Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Histogram.md for the offloaded-original, failed-preview and detached-Inspector checks.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Edited-Export.md for the loss report over a newer-build revision, the mid-batch cancel of a baked export, and the library-wide mode check; with a screen reader, Edits and JPEG quality are each read as one named radio group, the mode's hint as its description (#1306). The loss list is announced politely rather than as an alert, and a screen reader hears why Export is unavailable (confirm the edits, or include the withheld field) from the button's description (#1307).

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Variants.md for the edited-source duplicate, the offloaded-original deferral, the pre-33 library upgrade, and the backup/restore fidelity check over a real library. For #1121, confirm deferred previews remain pending across restart and appear with the saved transform immediately after restoring the shared original.
Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-AI-Provenance.md for the offloaded-original deferral and stale flag, the relaunch check, the restore fidelity check, and the purge cascade over a real library.

The visible native-window 200K harness is intentionally outside per-PR CI; invoke npm run test:perf when the engine changes. It retains three trials per zoom in test-results/perf-report.json and gates the median drop rate plus maximum worst frame. CI keeps the 2,000-row variant.

docs/acceptance/acceptance-test-full-display-image.md covers the portrait-width/landscape-height Fill matrix, physical macOS trackpad inertia, image-first chrome, cross-aspect-ratio focal continuity, Inspector geometry, and reset boundaries that Playwright cannot reproduce faithfully.

Issue #499 visual parity uses the immutable 924x540 design/handoff/references/06-lightbox-default-contain.png source plus the measured HandoffTransformToolbar story and docs/acceptance/acceptance-test-full-display-image.md for side-by-side, Inspector, 200% zoom, focus-state, and reduced-motion review.

Issue #968 square and extreme-aspect Fill behavior is covered by docs/acceptance/acceptance-test-full-display-image.md: cover on both axes with no bars on any side, and overflow confined to the single longer axis.

Run the signed macOS package against owner-supplied NEF, ARW, DNG, CR2, CR3, ORF, RW2, and RAF originals to validate Core Image camera support and confirm previews, repaired metadata, byte-faithful Original export, and zero persistent plaintext.

entries.$note: #885 adds library-wide unencrypted Original export. #992 binds selected, library-wide, moodboard, and protected-album destinations to single-use native-picker grants. The stories cover dialog variants, export-flow.spec.ts and moodboard.spec.ts exercise the picker-to-export path, and the authority tests enforce exact renderer/request binding.

coverage.reason: Follow the recovery copy-affordance section in docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Visual-Accessibility.md with VoiceOver or Narrator to verify unique button names, keyboard copy, selectable text, clipboard contents, and live success or failure announcements across restore and provider custody surfaces.

Native scrollbar rendering is invisible to hidden automation (#1285). In packaged builds, check at 1280px, the 960x600 minimum, and 200% zoom that the Settings pane, sidebar, Inspector, and dialog bodies scroll vertically only; that macOS shows an overlay scrollbar when the system hides scroll bars and a thin token-coloured bar when set to Always; that Windows shows a thin classic bar; and that forced-colors mode shows a system-coloured scrollbar.

Screen-reader reading of row names and hints is not observable from automation. Follow the Settings rows step in docs/acceptance/Manual-Test-A11y-VoiceOver.md with VoiceOver, at 640px and at 200% zoom.

Region announcement is not observable from automation. Follow step 1 of the inclusion rules in docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Gallery-Inclusion.md with VoiceOver and confirm entering the group reads "All Photos, region".
The tab list's announced orientation is not observable from automation. Follow the Settings section tabs step in docs/acceptance/Manual-Test-A11y-VoiceOver.md at 640px and at 200% zoom.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Appearance-Themes.md in a packaged macOS build to verify first-frame flash, native title-bar chrome, and live operating-system appearance changes that hidden automation cannot observe, and that corner radii and font weights read from the design scale (#1289).

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Appearance-Themes.md in packaged macOS and Windows builds to verify native reset recovery, renderer-failure rollback, OS accessibility precedence, and picker/drop behavior against physical files.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Appearance-Themes.md step 7 in a packaged build to verify the native save dialog, the exported file under Light and under an active custom theme, and the unchanged re-import.

A real packaged pCloud token is OS-keychain-sealed and cannot be safely fabricated or reused in automation. The packaged pass verifies the confirmation and restart UI; the Electron E2E lane exercises the real profile custody files with the unpackaged-only insecure keystore.

entries.$note: Manual purge uses a main-owned native confirmation bound to the exact validated photo-ID snapshot. The E2E harness covers the valid ceremony path and stale renderer acknowledgement rejection; unit coverage proves typed denial performs no purge or activity work and approval preserves the exact snapshot and activity summary.

coverage.reason: Verify native screen-lock, suspend/resume, user-switch, idle, minimize/hide, macOS native full-screen transitions, password-manager behavior, VoiceOver, reduced motion, and minimum-window layout in packaged macOS and Windows builds; CI injects the lifecycle events but cannot reproduce the physical OS surfaces or native full-screen animation ordering.

On a notarized Developer ID build on a Touch ID Mac: upgrade a working com.qwts.overlook profile to com.zts1.overlook and prove existing Electron safeStorage custody still opens the library and provider tokens; verify the explicit password-confirmed Touch ID re-enrollment path, restart/unlock, cancel, failed scan, lockout, enrollment change, password fallback, password-change revocation, opt-out, and Keychain item accessibility/synchronization attributes. CI cannot provide both signed identities, physical biometric hardware, or mutate the enrolled biometric set.

Verify usability-mode anchor repair and hardened-mode recovery on notarized macOS and Windows builds, including real Keychain or Credential Manager loss, Touch ID cancellation and failure classification, recovery-export acknowledgement, receipt expiry, single-use consumption, VoiceOver, and password-manager behavior. CI cannot remove platform credential-store records or exercise physical biometric hardware.

entries.$note: Folder drag verifies handle containment, native drag start, target feedback, atomic placement, refusal, focus, and persistence (#1104).

coverage.reason: Motion timings (120/200ms, easing) and hover fill progressions are visual-only rules with no cheap assertion surface; the disabled pattern (45% opacity + pointer-events) is exercised by component stories and every disabled-control play test, and copy/behavior rules are covered by the flow entries.

The sidebar connect line (#1302) is a sans sentence with Connect as its only control. In packaged builds, disconnect the provider and check at the 960x600 minimum and 200% zoom that the sentence wraps with Connect kept whole, that Tab reaches Connect with a visible focus ring, and that Enter opens Settings.

Use a packaged build to verify the native Move confirmation lists the exact requested paths, defaults to Cancel, leaves every source untouched on cancellation, and proceeds only after explicit confirmation.

Native Finder pointer ownership, drag cancellation outside Chromium, and packaged NEF drops require a signed or unsigned macOS package; E2E covers capture-boundary routing, modal child churn, focus loss, mixed RAW/JPEG/HEIC paths, unsupported files, repeated drops, and window/navigation denial.

Use a packaged build configured with the owner's Google Desktop OAuth client to verify the real system-browser Picker callback, multi-selection, supported and unsupported file handling, and that the configured backup provider and account remain unchanged.

entries.$note: Recovery-key import admits exactly one local .key file and explains empty, multi-file, wrong-extension, and pathless drops (#480).
Cloud restore exposes the same exact-one recovery-key picker and drop contract, with real-file drag coverage for multi-file, wrong-extension, and valid inputs (#480).

coverage.reason: The #270/#577 CSS region contracts and toolbar actions are automated, but native OS drag interception cannot be synthesized honestly - owner verifies window movement in the packaged app.
Packaged macOS and Windows acceptance verifies native mouse selection, keyboard copy, clipboard integration, and titlebar drag behavior that browser interaction tests cannot fully reproduce.

entries.$note: Issue #840 makes the Toast rapid-announcement story capture live-region mutations after play begins, so hosted Storybook timing cannot erase the first announcement before order is asserted.

coverage.reason: The VoiceOver pass is the half axe cannot automate: announcement order, live-region behaviour, and whether a screen-reader user can actually complete each flow. Run on macOS with docs/acceptance/Manual-Test-A11y-VoiceOver.md whenever a child of #381 lands a semantics change.

The switcher footer's key hint (#1300) depends on the dialog width the window allows. In packaged builds, open the switcher at 1280px, at the 960x600 minimum, and at 200% zoom: the hint sits on one row beside the buttons or is dropped entirely, never wrapped, and the buttons' focus rings stay visible.

entries.$note: Activity is reached only from Help → Activity… (#690), never a sidebar row; the Help-menu command and its dialog open are covered by application-menu.spec.ts, and Sidebar.stories.tsx regression-guards the row's absence.

coverage.reason: The signed provisioned macOS acceptance pass in docs/acceptance/Manual-Test-iCloud-Drive.md covers real Apple Account state changes, File Provider materialization, process restart, and fresh-profile disaster recovery that the deterministic Electron harness cannot reproduce.

docs/acceptance/acceptance-test-gif-webp-animated-media.md covers OS-level reduced-motion toggling, real animation timing/loop playback, and protected-album parity that the hidden Electron harness and Storybook cannot observe (prefers-reduced-motion is forced via a scoped matchMedia patch in stories).

Screen-reader traversal of the parallel reading-order list staying in sync with the role=application canvas, 200% text reflow of the panel and toolbar, and reduced-motion (no inertial/snap/drop animation) need the documented manual accessibility pass.

The offscreen-renderer poster decode (§6: capture.html/capture-frame.ts loaded in a hidden BrowserWindow, mpegts.js TS→fMP4 remux over MediaSource, capturePage of the first decodable frame) and encrypted-TS full-viewer playback run only inside the signed macOS/Windows package — MSE and the offscreen window are absent under headless unit/story runs. Validate against owner-supplied .ts/.mts/.m2ts originals per docs/acceptance/acceptance-test-mpeg-ts-video-media.md: deterministic poster on the tile, duration pill, no autoplay, keyboard-accessible playback, and byte-identical Original export.

Follow the Windows/Linux Overlook menu section of docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Native-Application-Menu.md in packaged Windows and Linux builds: placement beside Help, group headings and disabled-item reasons as a screen reader reads them, focus return from dialogs opened from the menu, and RTL and 200% zoom.

Follow the Titlebar Help Menu spec (§05/§08): on real Windows/Linux confirm no native menu bar renders, the titlebar Help button opens the ContextMenu with correct pointer placement and viewport-edge clamping across desktop-environment window-control layouts, RTL mirroring, reduced-motion, 200% text scaling, and native menu/menuitem screen-reader semantics that automated lanes cannot fully observe.
Full replace-run with the local key against a real provider is owner-verified on the packaged build; the engine path is identical to the recovery-key flow covered by restore-cloud.spec.ts.
A signed packaged macOS pass verifies disconnect, restart, reconnect, and recovery-key restore against the real iCloud container while stale or partial library homes remain present.

The relaunch-into-lock-screen custody check (restored library unlocks with the same app password) is owner-verified on the packaged build; the record + anchor semantics are covered by app-lock-credentials.test.ts and the engine seam by restore-engine.test.ts.

entries.$note: When no retained generation is complete, restore recovers everything that verifies, marks NOT FOUND originals ledger 'error', and reports the full missing list on the complete screen and in restore-report.json (#915). The strict complete-generation fallback (#741) is unchanged.

Verify-before-restore binds activation and triage exports to an opaque scan, projects a reduced internally consistent catalog, and reports the actual restored count. The automated cases cover clean and gap paths, stale plans, retained-generation fallback, exports, trash failure, diagnostics, and the four visible triage actions.

Verified-only restore binds to manifest identity (not an exact gap set), verify/run show 1/N progress, and closing Settings or the restore dialog leaves a status snapshot so the status-bar chip and Restore library… reopen the live job (#965).

coverage.reason: Close-and-reopen during a live cloud restore, the status-bar chip, and extra-gap activation after verify are owner-verified on a real provider in docs/acceptance/Manual-Test-M18-Cloud-Disaster-Recovery.md steps 6–7.

entries.$note: Verify originals with probe (no body download), always show Heal / Discard / Do nothing, move gaps aside on heal, and do not quit (#994).

coverage.reason: Owner verifies the results screen and no automatic quit on a real pCloud restore in docs/acceptance/Manual-Test-M18-Cloud-Disaster-Recovery.md steps 4 and 8.

entries.$note: Verify and restore classify not-found only from getStream ProviderError.kind === 'not-found'. provider.list is a disk-space hint; a listing miss that getStream can still read must restore (#969).

coverage.reason: A complete pCloud backup that verify used to report as all-NOT-FOUND is owner-verified in docs/acceptance/Manual-Test-M18-Cloud-Disaster-Recovery.md step 8.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Semantic-Embedding-Index.md on packaged macOS and Windows builds to verify native execution-provider fallback, battery transitions, and relaunch behavior that unit and Storybook lanes cannot observe.

The packaged-build check verifies real IPTC/XMP producer compatibility and authorized protected-domain presentation while byte identity and isolation are enforced by automated repository, import, export, and backup tests.

entries.$note: The signed production bridge reports disabled after native AppKit session startup was found to crash at in-window drag initiation (#1027). The harness retains bounded materialization coverage for a future safe redesign.

coverage.reason: The signed packaged check proves repeated in-window and outbound drag starts remain responsive with the native bridge disabled, internal album drag still works, and independent Finder/recovery-key inbound drops remain responsive.

The signed packaged check exercises the real macOS File Provider domain in Finder and Open dialogs, signed-extension isolation, on-demand/offloaded materialization, lock eviction, install/upgrade/disable/uninstall cleanup, and OS-owned cache disclosure; automated tests cover explicit consent, authenticated loopback transport, stable read-only projection, authorization races, custody release, and native/signing source policy.

The signed packaged pass exercises live PhotoKit permission states, limited and revoked access, iCloud-only assets, add-only export, supported metadata fidelity, and destination-owned retention; automated tests cover exact review scope, staging cleanup, lock refusal, native source policy, and the renderer/IPC flow.

Follow docs/acceptance/Acceptance-Test-Finder-Library-Document-And-Quick-Look.md in a signed packaged macOS build to verify Launch Services package identity, real Finder double-click routing, Quick Look isolation, and install, upgrade, and uninstall behavior.

Owner-verified on the packaged build against the real pre-Jul-20 iCloud backup (GEN 59): the verified partial restore completes, the NOT FOUND report lists the excluded objects, and the error panel's Copy error button places the reason and message on the system clipboard.
The login-keychain ACL is checked on a signed Overlook build. Unit tests use a fake port and do not call SecItem.
Announcements and the menu button role are heard, not observable from automation. Follow the library switcher step in section 8 of docs/acceptance/Manual-Test-A11y-VoiceOver.md.
